copy.seo_title: Car Rental Damage Process in Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: How CarmaCars handles the condition of a rental car: a walk-around with you at handover, clear terms before you request and no payment up front.
copy.h1: How damage is handled on a CarmaCars rental
copy.intro: Worried about what happens if something goes wrong with a rental car? It helps to know the steps before you book. With CarmaCars, a person hands the car over to you and walks around it with you, so you both see its condition at the start. Third-party liability coverage and roadside assistance come with every rental. You send a request first and pay only after we confirm, which leaves time to ask about anything you want explained.

sections.heading: The walk-around at handover
sections.body: When you collect the car or take delivery at your address, we hand it over in person and walk around it with you. You see the car as it is at the start of the rental, and you can point out anything you notice. It is a simple habit, and it keeps the start of every rental clear for you and for us.

sections.heading: What comes with every rental
sections.body: Every car lists what is included on its page. That includes third-party liability coverage and roadside assistance around the clock, along with a daily kilometre allowance. Read the car page for the details of the car you are looking at, since each one shows its own terms, and ask us if anything is unclear.

sections.heading: Ask before you request
sections.body: Requesting a car does not cost anything, because you pay only after we confirm. Use that time to ask how the rental works, what you need to bring and what to do if the car has a problem on the road. We answer in plain words, and we would rather you know the process now than wonder later.

faq.question: Is the car checked with me at pickup?
faq.answer: Yes. We hand the car over in person and walk around it with you, whether you collect it from us or we deliver it to your address.

faq.question: Do I pay when I send a request?
faq.answer: No. You send a request to book with no payment, and you pay after we confirm.

faq.question: What is included with every rental?
faq.answer: Third-party liability coverage, roadside assistance around the clock and a daily kilometre allowance, as listed on each car page.

faq.question: What do I need to bring to pick up a car?
faq.answer: An valid driver licence, a credit card in your name, and your licence and identity are checked before pickup.

copy.seo_title: Car Rental Deposit Explained in Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: What to know about the security deposit on a CarmaCars rental: each car page shows its own deposit, and you pay nothing until we confirm your request.
copy.h1: The car rental security deposit, explained
copy.intro: A security deposit is money held against a rental, and the amount depends on the car. That is why CarmaCars shows the deposit on each car page instead of hiding it in the checkout. You can see it next to the daily rate before you ask for anything. A request to book costs nothing, and you pay only after we confirm. Here is how the pieces fit together, so nothing about the deposit surprises you at pickup.

sections.heading: One deposit per car
sections.body: Deposits are not the same across the fleet. A compact sedan and a large luxury SUV carry different amounts, and each car page shows the figure for that car. Open the page of the car you like and read the deposit alongside the daily, weekly and monthly rates. If the number does not suit your plans, a different car may.

sections.heading: When you pay
sections.body: You do not pay anything when you send a request. We look at it, confirm it with you, and only then do you pay. This order means you can compare cars and ask questions without any money moving. If you have a question about how the deposit is handled, ask us before you confirm.

sections.heading: What you need at pickup
sections.body: Bring an valid driver licence and a credit card in your own name. Your licence and identity are checked before pickup. A card in someone else's name does not work for the booking, so plan ahead if the person paying is not the person driving.

faq.question: How much is the deposit?
faq.answer: It depends on the car. Each car page shows its own deposit next to the rates.

faq.question: Do I pay the deposit when I send a request?
faq.answer: No. A request to book has no payment. You pay after we confirm.

faq.question: Does the card have to be in my name?
faq.answer: Yes. We ask for a credit card in the renter's name.

faq.question: Can I ask about the deposit before booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask us before you confirm, and we will explain how it works for the car you chose.

copy.seo_title: Car Rental With Every Fee Shown Up Front | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: See what a CarmaCars rental costs before you ask: daily, weekly and monthly rates, delivery, return pickup, extra kilometres and tax on each car page.
copy.h1: Car rental with every fee up front in Toronto
copy.intro: Few things annoy renters more than a total that grows at the last step. CarmaCars lists the parts of the cost on each car page, so you can add them up yourself. You will find the daily, weekend, weekly and monthly rates, the delivery fee, the return pickup fee, the rate for extra kilometres, the deposit and a note that HST is added. This page explains where to look and what to expect.

sections.heading: Where the numbers are
sections.body: Every car has its own page, and each page shows its own rates and fees. Prices differ from car to car, so we do not print one set of figures here. Open the car you want and read the list from top to bottom. The same layout is used on every page, which makes two cars easy to compare.

sections.heading: Delivery, return and extra kilometres
sections.body: You can collect a car from us at no charge, or have it delivered to your address for the delivery fee shown on the car page. A return pickup has its own fee. Each rental includes a daily allowance of kilometres, and any extra kilometre is billed at the rate listed for that car.

sections.heading: Tax and timing
sections.body: HST is added to the rental. You send a request first and pay after we confirm, so you can check the full cost before any money moves. If a line on the page is unclear, ask us. Younger drivers should also read the notes about driver age on the car page.

faq.question: Are delivery and return pickup charged?
faq.answer: Collecting from us has no charge. Delivery and return pickup each have a fee, shown on the car page.

faq.question: Is tax included in the rate?
faq.answer: No. HST is added to the rental, and the car page says so.

faq.question: What happens if I drive more than the daily allowance?
faq.answer: Extra kilometres are billed at the per kilometre rate listed on the car page.

faq.question: When do I pay?
faq.answer: After we confirm your request. Sending a request does not take any payment.

faq.question: Is there a fee for younger drivers?
faq.answer: Some age groups have a young driver fee. Read the driver age notes on the car page before you request.
